item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Most people run slightly dehydrated without noticing, and it shows up as low focus, irritability, and tired afternoons. Your day has a lot of reflection and mental work in it, and a depleted brain makes all of that harder. Water is the cheapest support you have. Spread it out instead of catching up at night. Action: before your first meditation, drink a full glass of water.
